found_values.value: An output of the I/O expander, with a pull-down resistor that holds EN/UVLO below 0.4 V (VEN_L) while that output is an input. report.figure: Ceiling latch gap
report.value: No part that meets the HV band and passes rule 4 latches an overvoltage cut-off (V130); the Port voltage ceiling has no shortlisted part. TPS3701DDCR (JLCPCB 26866) and TLV6710DDCR (3303) release OUTB below VIT-(INB). TPS3703 latches, but its best JLCPCB row has 307 against 500 (C1849519, 15:21:45Z), and it also latches on an undervoltage and at start-up, so every port stays off until CT is driven. A TPS3701 OUTB on the ILM pin of a TPS25947xL latches the port off only above IFLT, 1.1 A typ, 2.1 A max, so an idle port is not cut off. Owner to decide: a firmware latch (firmware opens the port switch through the expander on the port monitor's reading, which leaves the reconnect to the detector until firmware acts), an added latch part a port driven by the detector, or an owner exception to the rule-4 gate for TPS3703
